queue.title: Colour correction fit
queue.notes: Tested M1/M2/M3 in sRGB and linear light on cluster-balanced flat samples with dark/bright anchors and Huber loss. Selected M2_srgb: held-out DE00 = 3.703 vs in-sample 3.864 (gap -0.161 <= 1.0), beating M1_srgb (5.043) and M2_linear (3.806) while generalizing better cross-pair A->B than M3_srgb (7.136 vs 7.701 DE00) with 22 vs 73 params. Recorded Joint and per-pair params, observed channel ranges, and exported 33^3 look.cube (will update after joint refit with spatial stages).

queue.title: Gradient / lower-area darkening
queue.notes: 2D surface R^2: vertical 70.2%/75.7% vs radial vignette 6.4%/0.5%. Visual inspection of row profiles confirmed pure smoothstep multiply gradient starting at y0=0.1733 and saturating at y1=0.7281 (strength_rgb=[0.250636, 0.255053, 0.292137]). Row-mean y correlation dropped from -0.9393/-0.9309 to -0.3514 (A) and +0.2994 (B). Full flat_interior median DE00: 2.408 (A), 2.775 (B).

queue.title: Order of operations and the full composite

results.cc_model: M2_srgb (per-channel Levels + neutral-preserving 3x3 colour matrix in gamma-encoded sRGB)

gradient.hypothesis: H1_vertical_spatial_multiply_gradient (smoothstep falloff with subtle RGB shadow tint)
gradient.coordinate_reference: Full frame height including letterbox bars (normalised y in [0, 1], 0 = top row, 1 = bottom row)
gradient.blend_formula: out = clamp(cc * (1.0 - smoothstep(y0, y1, y_norm) * strength_rgb), 0.0, 1.0)

unsharp.kernel: single-pass 25-tap (5x5 separable [1,4,6,4,1]/16 with bilinear UV offset = vec2(i,j) * sigma_px / resolution)
unsharp.formula: d = rgb - blur25(rgb, sigma_frac_h * H); d_t = sign(d) * max(abs(d) - threshold, 0.0); out = clamp(rgb + amount * d_t, 0.0, 1.0)

nuisance_pre_blur_excluded_from_spec.note: Accounts solely for AI-reconstruction sharpness vs export recompression/upscaling; NOT applied in look_apply.py or shader.

flare.model: 2D anisotropic rotated Gaussian radial glow with Screen blend
flare.blend_formula: f = intensity * exp(-0.5 * (u^2 + v^2)) * colour_rgb; out = 1.0 - (1.0 - base) * (1.0 - clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0))

global_veil_test.conclusion: Fitted uniform veil is <= 2.5/255 on Pair A (within the 3/255 reconstruction noise floor) and adds negligible LP energy reduction; excluded to prevent washing out global blacks.

canonical_default_params.source_basis: Pair A unambiguous top-right golden-warm haze flare (lifts dark hair [18,23,29] -> [78,77,62] without clipping straw-hat highlights, confirming Screen blend).

pairB_fitted_params.source_basis: Pair B subtle top-right cool sky haze lift ([32,51,48] -> [46,79,86] on upper-right cloak).

consistent_across_pairs: Top-right quadrant placement (cx ~ 0.85..0.92 of width, cy ~ 0.05..0.22 of height)
Broad soft spread (rx, ry ~ 0.20..0.34 of frame height)
Screen blend mode (lifts darks strongly while preserving bright highlights)
scene_dependent_or_animated: Intensity (0.24-0.28 strong glow on Pair A vs 0.09-0.12 subtle glow on Pair B)

Tint colour_rgb (warm golden-amber [0.95, 1.00, 0.40] matching straw-hat/sunlight in Pair A vs cool cyan [0.47, 0.96, 1.00] matching sky in Pair B — suggests either per-clip keyframing/tint selection or a source-tinted optical bloom/haze plugin).
consistency_and_scene_dependence.confidence: Medium-High on Pair A geometry & Screen blend; Low-Medium on cross-clip static colour/intensity invariance (expose flare_intensity, flare_pos, flare_radius, and flare_colour as Keyflaw user controls).
